reason: I do all my channel work in YouTube Studio with free vidIQ, TubeBuddy and ChatGPT, and I have never paid for a creator tool. Weekly tips sound useful, but I can get something similar for free, so I would not switch.
objection: Brand and local deals sound great, but small channels like mine never get them, so the biggest selling point feels like it is for someone else.
would_change_my_mind: A real example of a local deal that was offered to a channel my size in my own city, with the fee shown clearly before I accept.
